array.string: mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/mpm" /opt/homebrew/bin/mpm --no-color --table-format json outdated > "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.json" 2> "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.log" status=$? if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then rm -f "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.error" total=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/jq '[.[].packages | length] | add // 0' "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.json") if [ "$total" -gt 0 ]; then managers=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/jq '[.[] | select((.packages | length) > 0)] | length' "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.json") /opt/homebrew/bin/terminal-notifier -title "mpm-plan" -subtitle "Run 'mpm upgrade --all' to apply" -message "$total package update(s) across $managers manager(s)" -group "local.mpm-plan" fi else printf 'mpm outdated failed (exit %s) at %s -- see ~/.cache/mpm/plan.log\n' "$status" "$(date)" > "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.error" /opt/homebrew/bin/terminal-notifier -title "mpm-plan" -message "Check failed (exit $status) -- see ~/.cache/mpm/plan.log" -group "local.mpm-plan" fi
